newsitem.title: FINLAND: INSTANT VIEW - Amer K-share redemption.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Amer K-share redemption.

text.p: Following are some initial responses from equities analysts to Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy's announcement on Tuesday that it had redeemed 275,000 unlisted K series shares for 75 million markka and proposed a conversion of its K shares into A shares.
"The news is very positive for the company -- first of all that it will redeem the shares and second that the K and A shares series will be combined."
"All speculation will vanish once the company gets down to a single series of shares."
"The A shares will become much more interesting (once the series are combined) because earlier the K-shareholders, who have owned just a fraction of the company, have had control of it."
"I believe that the share will rise above 100.00 markka in the near term."
"This will remove uncertainty and clarify the situation."
"The news was positively received (by the market), but the share could run into some resistance at levels of 99.00 or 100.00 markka."
"This is a positive piece of news. (British investor Lord) Moyne, who was an uncertainty factor, will be out of the picture, and the share series will be combined."
"This will mean that new shares can come up for sale, so the dilution effect should also be taken into account."
"The market will take the news positively as Amer is finally getting rid of indecisive K-shareholders."
"In the short term, the share may rise a bit, but the fundamentals did not change."
